title: Glowing pear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffff99' stop-opacity='0.4'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#ccff66' stop-opacity='0.1'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#99cc33' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='pearBody' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#eaffaa'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#c8e86a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a8d84a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='38' ry='36' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Pear body -->
  <path d='M50 28 C50 28, 30 42, 30 60 C30 76, 40 86, 50 86 C60 86, 70 76, 70 60 C70 42, 50 28, 50 28 Z' fill='url(#pearBody)' stroke='#b8e05a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Bottom shading -->
  <path d='M50 60 C38 60, 33 70, 33 76 C36 83, 43 86, 50 86 C57 86, 64 83, 67 76 C67 70, 62 60, 50 60 Z' fill='#b0d84a' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='12' ry='16' fill='#f0ffbb' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- Stem -->
  <path d='M50 28 C50 24, 48 20, 49 16' fill='none' stroke='#8a6d3b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 28 C50 24, 52 21, 50 17' fill='none' stroke='#a08040' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Leaf -->
  <path d='M50 20 C56 14, 64 12, 68 16 C66 22, 58 24, 50 20 Z' fill='#7bc043'/>
  <path d='M50 20 C56 16, 62 15, 66 17' fill='none' stroke='#5a9a2a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M50 20 C52 18, 54 17, 56 17' fill='none' stroke='#9ad85a' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Shine dots -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='48' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.55'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='68' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Small sparkles -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#ffffcc' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#ffffcc' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='1' fill='#ffffcc' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='80' r='1' fill='#ffffcc' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
